Full description
Discover one of the most unique landscapes of the Atacama Desert in an experience that combines the Hidden Lagoons of Baltinache with a visit to the emblematic Magic Bus.

We will depart from San Pedro de Atacama towards Baltinache, crossing the landscapes of the Cordillera de la Sal until we reach this group of seven lagoons with intense turquoise tones, surrounded by salt formations and the immensity of the desert.

We will explore its trails and viewpoints with our guide, enjoying time to contemplate the landscape, learn about the natural characteristics of the area and take photographs.
Currently, swimming and floating are temporarily suspended by disposition of the local administration, as a measure of protection and maintenance of the lagoons. While this measure remains in force, we have adapted the experience by incorporating a visit to the Magic Bus, an old abandoned bus in the middle of the desert landscape that has become one of the most original and photogenic spots around San Pedro de Atacama.

In this way, the experience combines the natural beauty of Baltinache with a different desert setting, offering new opportunities to explore, discover and photograph Atacama.
During this period, a temporary reduced access fee to Baltinache also applies.

Know before you go
IMPORTANT – TEMPORARY CLOSURE FOR FLOATING: As of September 29, 2026, swimming and floating in the Escondidas de Baltinache Lagoons are temporarily suspended by park administration for protection and maintenance work.
The reopening of the lagoon enabled for floating is expected during December, with no specific date confirmed yet.
To ensure a smooth experience, we remind you that reservations for our tours must be made at least 10 hours in advance of departure time. This allows us to properly coordinate all the details and ensure your adventure is unforgettable. Thank you for your understanding!
Payment must be made in advance before the start of the itinerary, preferably in cash. We will contact you to request payment. If the booking is last minute, we will request payment. Payments made through the payment link may incur a 4% surcharge due to taxes.
